name: Lizard

modes.label: Sandbox measured usage (4 vCPU / 4 GiB fixed template)
modes.note: Measured usage, not reservation; exact RAM statistic undocumented. Reject requested RAM >4 GiB; not a valid 4/8 quote. Snapshot retention unsupported; paused state resides in host memory.

plans.name: Pro PAYG
plans.note: Account capacity limits unpublished; enterprise terms custom.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Custom contract adds custom replica limits, SOC 2/HIPAA compliance, SSO/SAML, RBAC/audit log, SLA support and dedicated nodes on demand. Sandbox account concurrency is still not published.

caveats: Public sandbox API is fixed 4 vCPU / 4096 MiB; app quotas of 20 vCPU/40 GB do not establish sandbox sizing. Cannot serve a single 4 vCPU/8 GiB sandbox as documented.

Marketing advertises custom templates, snapshots and shared volumes; newer sandbox docs restrict create to base/code-interpreter-v1, single-attached node-local volumes and non-durable host-memory pause. Docs take precedence.
Pause/expiration lifecycle has a documented unresolved backend issue. Timeout may expire while paused; no guaranteed long-term retention.
Exact measured-memory accounting, minimum billing, payment processing fee and minimum top-up amount unpublished.
Concurrency capacity is account-limited but no verified numeric sandbox concurrency guarantee for 50 is published.
90 ms marketing cold-start claim differs from 200 ms llms index; neither is an independently measured benchmark.
No confirmed durable named user snapshots or public fork API; do not treat pause as backup.
Volume meter $0.141912/GiB per 730-hour month cannot be stored as snapshot_gib_month; retained VM snapshots are not offered.
Enterprise pricing absent; public mode only. Trial expires in 31 days.

Root filesystem size of a sandbox is not published; all requested disk is priced at the volume rate $0.000000054/GB/s (~$0.1419/GB-month) as an upper bound. Volumes are single-attached and node-local.

Purchased credits do not expire, but the $10 trial credit expires after 31 days. Auto top-up is optional. The minimum top-up and payment fee are only displayed inside the authenticated top-up screen and remain unknown.

When credit reaches zero, creation can be restricted and running services can pause after an unspecified grace period. The public page does not publish the grace duration or retention/deletion deadline.

Volumes are 1–50 GB by current public default, 5 GB default, one sandbox attachment at a time, node-local, and billed on used space rather than allocated size. The engine's requested-GB multiplication is therefore an upper bound for sparse volumes.

Dashboard sandboxes created manually have no timeout; SDK default is five minutes; raw API timeoutMs=0 means no expiration and the maximum explicit millisecond timeout is 2147483647. Commands do not reset lifetime.

Pro's advertised 20 vCPU/40 GB and 5 replicas apply to applications, not Sandbox size or account fleet capacity. Public Sandbox create remains fixed at 4 vCPU/4096 MiB, and the effective account cap must be obtained from the provider.

fleet.verification: Signup page determines whether payment method is required; published $10 trial credit does not prove no-card access.
fleet.notes: Limits docs explicitly warn not to equate app caps with sandbox capacity. Sandbox create shape 4 vCPU/4 GiB is not account total; advertised thousands parallel is not new-account quota. Ask provider for effective account cap before sizing any fleet.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

snapshot_auto.quote: After it stops, only files written to an attached Persistent Volume at `/workspace` can be reused by a later sandbox.
snapshot_auto.note: Nothing is saved automatically on stop/expiry; lifetime is a fixed deadline, not an idle timer. Pause/resume return HTTP 501.

snapshot_on_demand.quote: Pause, resume, fork, snapshot, restore, and file watching currently return HTTP 501.
snapshot_on_demand.note: Dashboard: 'Creating user snapshots, pausing, and resuming are not supported.' Marketing page: 'User-created snapshots are not available.'

harness_api.quote: | `sandbox.process.exec(cmd)` | Run a shell command; return stdout, stderr, and exitCode. |
harness_api.note: SDK surface is create/connect/list/getInfo, process.exec, fs.*, getHost, setTimeout, kill. A 'codex' template exists (harness preinstalled = agent_harnesses), but no API to drive it; command timeouts 1-600 s.

secret_proxy.quote: Create-time `envs` and `metadata` are also not applied.
secret_proxy.note: No credential proxy documented. The platform's secrets are env vars merged into app services' environments (docs/variables); for sandboxes even create-time env vars are not applied, so credentials have to be passed in via commands/files.

volume_attach.quote: A volume in Lizard (lizard.build) keeps data after a sandbox stops. It mounts at **`/workspace`** and attaches to **one sandbox at a time**.
volume_attach.note: Named node-local volumes 1-50 GB (default 5), billed on used space; attached at create; survive sandbox kill but not node loss.

volume_shared.quote: An attached volume cannot attach to another sandbox or be deleted.
volume_shared.note: Single attachment only (read-write). Managed S3 object storage exists as a platform addon but is not a sandbox mount.
